name: Hamlib 4.7.2
body:
### Version 4.7.2 Release of Hamlib and included utilities.

Along with the GNU Autotools generated source archive, `hamlib-4.7.2.tar.gz`, binary packages for Windows 32 and 64 bit systems are included as both a ZIP file or self extracting EXE file.

All files are signed by N0NB's gpg key for additional assurance.

**Note:**  The files named `Source code (zip)` and `Source code (tar.gz)` are generated by GitHub and require a complete installation of the GNU Autotools to bootstrap the build system.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/compare/4.7.1...4.7.2

name: Hamlib 4.5
body:
### Version 4.5 Release of Hamlib and included utilities.

Along with the GNU Autotools generated source archive, `hamlib-4.5.tar.gz`, binary packages for Windows 32 and 64 bit systems are included as both a ZIP file or self extracting EXE file.

All files are signed by N0NB's gpg key for additional assurance.

**Note:**  The files named `Source code (zip)` and `Source code (tar.gz)` are generated by GitHub and require a complete installation of the GNU Autotools to bootstrap the build system.

## What's Changed
* Some vfo preparation commits to support Icom SATMODE  by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/149
* Warning cleanup and fix for VFOA/B split on SATMODE rigs by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/151
* Fix & re-map Icom receiver DCS function calls by @malcolmh in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/152
* Fix Icom split set for rigs with Main/Sub by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/153
* Several fixes by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/154
* Prepare for D-STAR implementation by @malcolmh in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/156
* Allow IC-7410 to send cw messages by @karvanitis in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/160
* Lots of cppcheck cleanups still in progress by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/155
* TS-690 improvements by @cruvolo in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/163
* 2020-01-05 Patches by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/168
* icom.c can now power up icom rigs and determine USB echo status by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/172
* CPPCheck changes by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/174
* 2020-01-17 patches by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/178
* IC746 memory fix and rig_mem_count restore by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/181
* 2020-01-19 patches by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/183

* Add -ldl to tests/Makefile.am by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/185
* 2020-01-23 patches by @mdblack98 in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/187
* ICOM Voice Keyer implemented. by @sq6emm in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/191

* additional error checking for extended operations by @malcolmh in https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/pull/199

name: Hamlib 4.4
body:
### Version 4.4 Release of Hamlib and included utilities.

Along with the GNU Autotools generated source archive, `hamlib-4.4.tar.gz`, binary packages for Windows 32 and 64 bit systems are included as both a ZIP file or self extracting EXE file.

All files are signed by N0NB's gpg key for additional assurance.

**Note:**  The files named `Source code (zip)` and `Source code (tar.gz)` are generated by GitHub and require a complete installation of the GNU Autotools to bootstrap the build system.

name: Hamlib 4.0
body:
### Version 4.0 Release of Hamlib and included utilities.

**ABI incompatibility with prior releases!** At a minimum client software will need to be recompiled.  Client software and end users need to be aware that all rig model numbers have changed.  See `rigctl -l` for the complete list.

Along with the GNU Autotools generated source archive, `hamlib-4.0.tar.gz`, binary packages for Windows 32 and 64 bit systems are included as both a ZIP file or self extracting EXE file.
